parameters.content:
## BOXX - Lead Intake | Email + SMS consent (2026-10-14)
Webhook `/webhook/boxx-lead` receives `/audit` form.

**Website payload:** `email_marketing_consent` and `sms_marketing_consent` as booleans. Both unchecked by default. SMS only sent when opt-in + phone valid.

**Leads columns to add:** `email_marketing_consent`, `email_consent_at`, `email_consent_source`, `sms_marketing_consent`, `sms_consent_at`, `sms_consent_source`, `sms_status`, `sms_opt_out_date` (optional), `sms_opted_out` (optional). Existing `unsubscribe_status` remains authoritative for email.

**New tab:** `SMS Events` with headers `event_id, lead_id, email, channel, email_type, sent_at, message_id, status, phone`. Existing `Error Log` and `Email Events` unchanged.

**Twilio:** Existing account credential name `Twilio account` is referenced; select/rebind it on import if n8n asks. Enter SMS-capable sender E.164 phone in Config `twilioFromNumber`. Requires Twilio SMS enabled and recipients opted in; test on own verified number if using Twilio trial. Reply STOP must be separately processed by a Twilio inbound webhook/opt-out workflow (not built here).

**Email 1:** Plain-text-style framework fulfillment, sent for new qualifying audit submissions even if email marketing unchecked. No promotional booking link. Its successful send sets `framework_delivered` and `nurture_status` ACTIVE only with effective email marketing consent, otherwise HELD. Email 2-5 enforcement REQUIRES a separate Scheduler patch; do not enable Scheduler before patch.

**SMS 1:** One welcome SMS with Calendly booking link after Email 1 is recorded as sent, only with SMS consent. Failed/invalid sends logged. No SMS on duplicate submissions.

**Important:** No secret keys in this JSON; preserve/select existing credentials. Do not replace the live workflow until tested. Duplicate prevention is best-effort only; concurrent submissions need a unique-lock/idempotency strategy for production.

Reviewed repository revision: strict boolean consent; legacy SMS opt-outs preserved; welcome attempt reserved in Leads; Twilio automatic retries disabled; accepted/failed results recorded. Set twilioFromNumber before SMS can send. Concurrent duplicate protection still requires serialized execution or an atomic lock. Nurture Scheduler patch and inbound STOP handler remain separate requirements.
